accessibility.description: Access Never Changes speaks through NVDA or Windows voices and adds keyboard access to menus, character creation, dialogue, barter, the inventory, the Pip-Boy, turn-based combat and the world map, plus hex-by-hex exploration with a scanner and an action menu. It requires the Fallout 2 Restoration Project (RPU) and a physical numpad, which drives movement and map functions; overhaul mods such as Fallout Nevada or Sonora are unlikely to work. Tested on the Steam version (GOG should work but is untested). The mod is still in progress: the opening main menu uses its own single-key controls rather than arrows, opening cinematics are undescribed, some error screens are not yet accessible, and driving the Highwayman is not yet supported.
